name: FinanzOnline / Austrian Tax
description: Generate FinanzOnline-ready U30 (USt-Voranmeldung) and ZM (Zusammenfassende Meldung) XML files for manual upload in FinanzOnline.

apiKey.instructions: Enter your FinanzOnline Webservice user credentials (FinanzOnline: Admin > Benutzerverwaltung > Webservice user). Stored encrypted and used only for direct submission to FinanzOnline. The Hersteller-ID defaults to your company UID (set in the integration settings).

fields.label: Hersteller-ID (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to use your company UID (ATU) as the Hersteller-ID. Only set this if BMF issued you a different Hersteller-ID.

uid.title: UID (ATU)
uid.description: Austrian VAT identification number in ATU + 8-digit form (e.g. ATU12345678). Also used as the FinanzOnline Hersteller-ID when submitting, unless overridden in the connection.

finanzamt.title: Finanzamt / Dienststelle
finanzamt.description: Optional. FinanzOnline usually derives the Finanzamt from the FASTNR.

periodFrequency.title: Voranmeldungszeitraum
periodFrequency.description: Reporting frequency for the U30 / ZM.

companyName.title: Company / Business Name
companyName.description: Business name written into the generated file (KUNDENINFO).

exports.name: U30 USt-Voranmeldung (FinanzOnline)
exports.description: Build a FinanzOnline-ready U30 XML for a single reporting period, ready to upload yourself in FinanzOnline.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

exports.name: ZM Zusammenfassende Meldung (FinanzOnline)
exports.description: Build a FinanzOnline-ready ZM (U13) XML for a period: one line per customer EU-VAT-ID with summed intra-EU B2B net turnover.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

actions.name: Preview U30 figures
actions.description: Compute the U30 Kennzahlen for a period and return them as JSON for review, including a list of unmapped documents that need attention. Read-only; AI-callable.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

actions.name: Submit U30 to FinanzOnline
actions.description: Build the U30 (USt-Voranmeldung) for a period and submit it to FinanzOnline via the webservice using the connected credentials. Defaults to a non-binding TEST transmission; set production=true to file for real.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

production.title: File for real (production)
production.description: When false (default), sends a non-binding test transmission. When true, files the U30 with FinanzOnline.

actions.name: Submit ZM to FinanzOnline
actions.description: Build the ZM (Zusammenfassende Meldung) for a period and submit it to FinanzOnline via the webservice using the connected credentials. Defaults to a non-binding TEST transmission; set production=true to file for real.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

production.title: File for real (production)
production.description: When false (default), sends a non-binding test transmission. When true, files the ZM with FinanzOnline.
